# HASP Checklist

> An interactive, printable checklist of what a HAZWOPER site safety and health plan must address under 29 CFR 1910.120(b)(4). Tick items off, save progress in your browser and print.

HASP Checklist (https://safety-plan-checklist.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Supervisor, Supervisor Refresher, Train-the-Trainer, 40-Hour HAZWOPER training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://safety-plan-checklist.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Guides

- [Writing a HASP your crew will actually use](https://safety-plan-checklist.hazwoperosha.us/guides/writing-a-hasp-crews-will-use): Complete isn't the same as usable. How to make the plan work on the tailgate.
- [Inspecting and updating the site safety plan](https://safety-plan-checklist.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hasp-inspections-and-updates): The plan has to be checked and updated as work goes on. How to make that routine.
